description: This file defines the RecyclingBitmapDrawable class, a specialized subclass of BitmapDrawable that manages reference counting to determine when to recycle its bitmap to optimize memory usage within an Android application.

classes.name: RecyclingBitmapDrawable
classes.description: A custom drawable that tracks display and cache states to determine appropriate times to recycle its bitmap resource.

methods.name: RecyclingBitmapDrawable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the drawable with resources and a bitmap.

methods.name: setIsDisplayed
methods.description: Increments or decrements the display reference count based on whether the drawable is currently being displayed, and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: setIsCached
methods.description: Increments or decrements the cache reference count based on whether the drawable is cached, and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: checkState
methods.description: Checks the current reference counts and display state to decide if the bitmap should be recycled.

methods.name: hasValidBitmap
methods.description: Verifies whether the drawable's bitmap exists and has not already been recycled.
